segments.name: EV charging
segments.description: Provides EV charging hardware, software and services to businesses, fleet operators, CPOs, e-Mobility Service Providers and automakers across North America and Europe.
segments.evidence: ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. ("ChargePoint" or the "Company") is a leading provider of electric vehicle ("EV") charging technology solutions to customers that want to offer EV charging, driving the transition to electric mobility across North America and Europe.

revenueModel.text: ChargePoint generates revenue from sales of Networked Charging Systems hardware, subscription software (ChargePoint Platform and Assure) billed upfront, and professional services sold to charging station owners and operators.
revenueModel.evidence: ChargePoint primarily generates revenue from the sale of its Networked Charging Systems, sales of a variety of software solutions that comprise the ChargePoint Platform and are offered as a subscription billed upfront regardless of term, sale of its Assure and other service programs as a subscription billed upfront regardless of term, and sales of its professional services.
